label: 4S underwater thruster — CW source form
designation: Underwater thruster with built-in ESC for4S, CW/CCW pair per BOM
requirements: Purchased functional unit. Its CAD internals must not become print/CNC definitions or additional procurement items.
BOM quantity4 means four CW/CCW pairs,8 complete thrusters. Mirrored CAD does not by itself establish the installed electrical rotation assignment.
Purchased functional equipment. CAD internals are installation references and must never be printed or machined.
normalization: Origin at rear measured envelope on shroud axis; +Z follows the shaft through the shroud. CW/CCW identifies source paired geometry; verify actual electrical direction on the delivered pair.
